data.action: 把扳手扛在肩上，比了个大拇指
data.description: 【森蚺 · 扳手英姿】重型装配台前，森蚺潇洒地将一米多长的巨型管钳扳手扛在肩上，冲着镜头自信地比起大拇指，粗壮的鳄鱼尾巴在身后欢快地晃动——「无论是机械故障还是来袭的敌人，只要有我和丑东西在，一扳手下去就能全部解决！」
data.promptProse: Outside the Rhodes workshop, Eunectes balances a giant pipe wrench on one shoulder and gives a confident thumbs-up with her free hand, thick tail swaying behind. Dark-green halter top, tactical vest, leather shorts and heavy work boots retain the mechanical outfit. The medium view includes the open workshop entrance and machinery beyond. Golden workshop light illuminates wrench and raised thumb, with darker doorway recesses and soft tail shadows along the ground.
data.title: 森蚺 · 扳手英姿
